notes: Tax code structure only. effective_from 2026-01-01 is the date this pack's data starts, not the date any law took effect. A rate of null means no figure has been confirmed from an official source; it is never guessed. Rates are percentages (12.5 = 12.5 %). A rate with status 'researched' comes from public research (docs/country-packs-research-2026-10.md): it is used, with its confidence, research date and sources, and what it taxes says so until the owner confirms it through a pack release (ADM-04).
todo: Fuel (Fuel station module): which excise duty, road maintenance levy and other charges apply to petrol, diesel, kerosene and LPG, whether they are itemised on the receipt or part of the pump price, and the regulator's maximum retail prices. A specific amount per litre is not a percentage tax code, so none is built in; the fuel item's tax category carries only the VAT code.

Tourism and catering levies (Hotel module): whether they apply to room and food charges, their rates, base and legal reference, and whether they are tax codes of this pack. Hotel applies only the tax codes a company lists in its settings; no rate is built in.
VAT_STD: confirm the researched 16% standard TVA rate (Code de la TVA) with its legal reference; it is used now, marked researched.
VAT_ZERO: confirm the researched 0% rate on exports and its official name.
Reduced TVA rates: sources cite 1%, 5% or 8% inconsistently (low confidence), so none is entered; confirm which apply, with legal references.
Excise duty (droits d'accises): which codes apply, their rates or specific amounts, with legal references.
Withholding taxes that apply at the point of sale, if any, with rates and legal references.
fiscal_code: the DGI tax group for each code on normalised invoices (needed for the e-MCF integration, phase 4).
VAT_EXEMPT: confirm the official name and that it maps to the DGI group.
